title: Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial? Revisiting Its Impact on LLM Performance
abstract: arXiv:2610.35328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Constrained decoding guarantees that Large Language Models (LLMs) produce outputs conforming to predefined formats, but is often assumed to inherently degrade reasoning. We examine this assumption through a taxonomy of three constraint types: \emph{format constraints}, which enforce output structure; \emph{validity constraints}, which mask invalid answer; and \emph{reasoning constraints}, which restrict reasoning trajectories. We theoretically show that appropriate constraints can preserve or improve performance by eliminating invalid paths. Across four model families and eleven open-source models, causal ablations on diverse benchmarks using state-of-the-art constrained decoding strategies reveal that apparent performance degradation largely stems from non-equivalent prompting and output formats rather than from decoder-level masking. Meanwhile, validity constraints improve reliability and extractability by eliminating invalid answers

translated_title: 约束解码：有害还是有益？重新审视其对大语言模型性能的影响
translated_abstract: 约束解码保证大语言模型（LLM）产生符合预定义格式的输出，但人们通常假设它会固有地损害推理能力。我们通过一个包含三种约束类型的分类体系来检验这一假设：*格式约束*（强制输出结构）、*有效性约束*（屏蔽无效答案）以及*推理约束*（限制推理轨迹）。我们从理论上证明，适当的约束可以通过消除无效路径来保持甚至提升性能。在四个模型家族和十一个开源模型上，使用最先进的约束解码策略在多样化基准上进行的因果消融实验表明，表观的性能下降主要源于非等效的提示词和输出格式，而非解码器层面的屏蔽。同时，有效性约束通过消除无效答案，提高了输出的可靠性和可提取性。
tldr: 该研究将约束解码划分为格式、有效性和推理三类约束，并通过理论与跨四个模型家族的因果消融实验证明，性能下降主要源于提示与输出格式的不等效而非解码器屏蔽本身，而适当的约束（尤其是有效性约束）反而能保持甚至提升模型性能与可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows through theory and causal ablations across four model families that the apparent performance degradation of constrained decoding stems mainly from non-equivalent prompting and output formats rather than decoder-level masking, while appropriate constraints—especially validity constraints—can preserve or even improve performance and reliability.
